new_choices_and_clarifications.bootstrap: pointwise paired percentile bootstrap95% of mean effect;10000 whole-cluster resamples with replacement
new_choices_and_clarifications.bootstrap_learning_scope: Apply the same95% and10000 settings to learning and execution contrasts; learning details are a new prospective clarification.
new_choices_and_clarifications.cross_contrast_resampling: separate deterministic per-contrast streams; every replicate resamples the complete paired cluster difference, never separate method arms
new_choices_and_clarifications.effect_size_dz: mean paired difference / paired sample SD(ddof1); undefined with explicit null value/status when SD0
new_choices_and_clarifications.endpoint_and_tie_arithmetic: exact rational hypervolumes and integer-scaled differences; no floating tie tolerance
new_choices_and_clarifications.global_alpha: 1/20 (0.05), only after all12 prespecified contrasts close
new_choices_and_clarifications.holm: exact rational Holm step-down; all12 prescribed IDs required for adjustment/reject labels; alpha-boundary rejection uses adjusted p<=1/20
new_choices_and_clarifications.null: paired whole-cluster joint sign-flip symmetry/exchangeability; not a distribution-free test of a zero mean alone
new_choices_and_clarifications.paired_t: 95% pointwise descriptive sensitivity, df19, sample SD with ddof1, same20cluster differences; zero variance produces degenerate[mean,mean] with explicit status
new_choices_and_clarifications.partial_family: raw tests and pointwise CIs only, marked provisional/descriptive; no adjusted_p_value or reject fields
new_choices_and_clarifications.percentile_quantile: linear interpolation (NumPy method="linear"; rational type7 rank (B-1)*q at q=1/40 and39/40)
new_choices_and_clarifications.rounding: exact fractions retained alongside decimal display; decimals never determine exact tests or Holm decisions
new_choices_and_clarifications.seed_derivation: first8 SHA256 digest bytes interpreted as unsigned big-endian integer of UTF-8 recipe_id + "/" + canonical contrast ID
new_choices_and_clarifications.sign_flip_enumeration: all 2^20 assignments, including observed; zeros retained; inclusive absolute-statistic tail; no Monte Carlo +1 correction
new_choices_and_clarifications.test_statistic: absolute mean of paired training-cluster endpoint differences

software_control_scope: synthetic math/receipt controls only; no scientific results generated
